version: v3 2026-10-16: name-only state, content-type subcategories with music video kept, foreign = no English audio (separate yes/no for tv and movies), subcategory accepted on its probability

root.instructions: Which kind of content is this Usenet release? Judge from the release name.

criteria.tv: Episodic television: a series episode or season pack. Signs: S01E02, 1x05, 'Episode 8', 'Season 3', a daily-show date like 2026.08.14, HDTV/PDTV, sports events (NFL, UFC, F1, Olympics), documentary series, anime episodes from fansub groups in brackets like [SubsPlease] or [Moozzi2] followed by an episode number. Not for a film with a single year and no episode marker, and not for music concerts.
criteria.movies: A feature film: a title followed by a release year, written with dots or with spaces (Inception.2010.1080p.BluRay.x264-SPARKS, 'The Imposter 2012 Bluray-1080p', 'Gangster (2006)'), usually with quality or source tokens such as 1080p, 2160p, BluRay, WEB-DL, DVDRip, x264, x265, CAM, telesync, or a language like German, FRENCH, Hindi, Telugu. Also DVD and Blu-ray disc images of films. Not for anything with a season or episode marker, not for adult studio scenes, not for concerts.
criteria.audio: Music or spoken audio: albums, singles, discographies, FLAC, MP3, 320kbps, vinyl or CD rips, soundtracks, DJ mixes, music videos and concert films, audiobooks (Unabridged, Narrated, Audible, Read By), podcasts. Not for films, TV series or ebooks.
criteria.xxx: Adult pornographic content: an adult studio or site name (Brazzers, Vixen, Tushy, Blacked, OnlyFans, NaughtyAmerica, Kink, Playboy, ALSScan), a performer name followed by a scene title ('Esmi Lee - Coworker In Chastity'), fetish or femdom scene titles, the token XXX, a site-dated scene like Site.26.08.14.Performer.Name, VR adult, erotic image sets or adult magazines. Not for a mainstream film title with a year, and not for a series whose title merely contains a sexual word.
criteria.games: A console video game: PlayStation (PS2, PS3, PS4, PS5, PSP, PS Vita, CUSA or PPSA ids), Xbox (XBOX360, Xbox One, Series X), Nintendo (Wii, WiiU, 3DS, NDS, Switch, NSP, XCI), or retro ROM sets with region tags (USA, EUR, JPN, NTSC, PAL). Not for PC games.
criteria.pc: Computer software or a PC game: Windows, macOS or Linux applications with version numbers and tokens like x64, Multilingual, Portable, Keygen, Cracked, Patch, Setup, MSIX; operating system or software ISO images; iOS and Android apps (IPA, APK); PC games with tokens like CODEX, RUNE, GOG, Steam. Not for console games.
criteria.books: Written material: ebooks (EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF with a book title or author), magazines (a magazine title with an issue number, month and year), comics and manga (CBR, CBZ, publisher names), technical books (O'Reilly, Packt, Apress, Manning). Not for audiobooks, video courses or software manuals bundled with software.
criteria.other: Nothing above fits: a random or encoded string, a hash, a filename with no title, a video training course, advertising or a website name, a data dump, or a name that gives no clue what the content is.

readable.instructions: Is the release name a human-readable title that says what the content is, rather than a random string, hash, encoded text, or bare file name?

adult.instructions: Does the release name describe adult pornographic content?

tv.instructions: Which kind of TV programme is this release?

criteria.anime: Anime: an animated series made in Japan, whatever language it is released in.
criteria.sport: A sports event or sports programme: league or event names (NFL, NBA, UFC, F1, WWE, Olympics), teams, round or match
criteria.documentary: A documentary or docu-series: 'Documentary', 'Docu', factual nature, science or history programmes
criteria.other: Television that is none of the above

foreign.instructions: Is this film or series in a language other than English, with no English audio?

criteria.true: It is in another language and has no English audio: a title in another language or script, or a name marked German, FRENCH, Dutch, Swedish, Spanish, ITA, Castellano, Korean, Hindi, Tamil or Telugu, or dubbed into such a language without English.
criteria.false: It is in English, including an English film or series that only adds foreign subtitles (such as NLsub or German Sub) or that carries an extra dubbed audio track next to the English one.

criteria.other: A film that is not 3D, or where 3D cannot be told from the name

foreign.instructions: Is this film or series in a language other than English, with no English audio?

criteria.true: It is in another language and has no English audio: a title in another language or script, or a name marked German, FRENCH, Dutch, Swedish, Spanish, ITA, Castellano, Korean, Hindi, Tamil or Telugu, or dubbed into such a language without English.
criteria.false: It is in English, including an English film or series that only adds foreign subtitles (such as NLsub or German Sub) or that carries an extra dubbed audio track next to the English one.

audio.instructions: Which kind of audio release is this?

criteria.audiobook: An audiobook: Audiobook, Unabridged, Abridged, Narrated, Read By, Audible, M4B, Tantor, Blackstone
criteria.podcast: A podcast episode or series: Podcast, NPR, BBC Sounds, Wondery, Gimlet
criteria.video: A music video, concert film, live show, tour or festival recording with video tokens such as 1080p, BluRay, x264, MKV, MP4
criteria.foreign: Music in or from a non-English market when the name says so: German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Korean
criteria.other: Music that is none of the above

xxx.instructions: What kind of adult release is this?

criteria.vr: Virtual reality adult video: VR, VR180, VR360, Oculus, Quest, GearVR, a VR site name like VRBangers, SexBabesVR, WankzVR
criteria.imageset: A set of adult photos or an adult magazine, not a video.
criteria.pack: A pack or collection of many adult videos or scenes in one release.
criteria.clipshd: A single adult scene or clip in high definition, 720p or better.
criteria.clipssd: A single adult scene or clip in standard definition, below 720p.
criteria.other: A single adult video that is none of the above, or whose quality cannot be told.

criteria.xboxone: Xbox One or Series X|S: XBOXONE, XB1, XBONE, XSX, XSS
criteria.xbox: Original Xbox: XBOX with no 360 or One
criteria.other: Another console: PS5, Switch, PS1, PS2, SNES, NES, SEGA, Game Boy, Dreamcast, N64, Atari, or a console that cannot be told

pc.instructions: Which PC subcategory fits this release?

criteria.phone_ios: iOS or iPhone app: iOS, iPhone, iPad, IPA
criteria.phone_other: An app for another phone platform
criteria.mac: macOS software: Mac, macOS, OSX, DMG
criteria.games: A PC game: scene game groups (CODEX, RUNE, PLAZA, TENOKE, GOG, FLT, SKIDROW), Steam, Repack, DLC for Windows
criteria.iso: A software or operating-system disc image or installer image: ISO, IMG, bootable, Ubuntu, Windows install media, training course images
criteria.0day: Windows or Linux application: a product name with a version number and tokens like x64, x86, Multilingual, Portable, Keygen, Cracked, Patch, Setup, Regged, MSIX

books.instructions: Which Books subcategory fits this release?

criteria.magazines: A magazine issue: a magazine title with an issue or volume number, a month and year, or a season and year (Wired October 2026, Issue 42, Vol 7)
criteria.comics: Comics or manga: CBR, CBZ, Marvel, DC, Image, Dark Horse, Vertigo, manga volume numbers
criteria.technical: A technical or programming book from a technical publisher: O'Reilly, Packt, Apress, Manning, No Starch, Wiley, Pearson, Addison-Wesley
criteria.foreign: A book in a language other than English, or marked German, French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian
criteria.ebook: An ebook or novel: EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF, Kindle, 'Author - Title', retail ebook
criteria.unknown: Written material but none of the above can be told from the name
